summary: Remote WebSocket relay drives arbitrary shell execution on installer host
details: src/index.js opens a persistent WebSocket connection to a hardcoded relay at wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app. On receipt of a message with type 'diagnosis' where autoFix is truthy, the relay-supplied fixCommand string is passed directly to child_process.execSync on the installer's host with no allowlist, signature verification, or user confirmation. Anyone controlling or impersonating the relay endpoint obtains arbitrary full-host command execution as the user running the agent. The package also reads os.hostname() and system info that is reported to the relay, and a --install-service flag installs auto-start persistence via systemd user units, macOS LaunchAgents, or Windows scheduled tasks (schtasks /create /sc onlogon /rl highest), causing the relay-controlled exec path to survive reboots. Additional hardcoded endpoints referenced include https://opencode.ai and https://rfsbovvvryfmgpoehlrc.supabase.co.
